input.title: Fix column header parsing error for quoted headers
input.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Fix the parsing of the CSV header line to correctly handle quoted column names. Currently, the header is split by commas without unquoting, so headers with quotes cause the column count to mismatch the data rows. The fix is to use the same splitFields function for parsing the header line, so that quoted headers are handled correctly, allowing files with quoted headers to be parsed without error.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The issue is caused by incorrect parsing of the header line, which is split on commas without removing quotes, causing the column count to mismatch data rows when headers are quoted. The file src/ingest/parser.ts is responsible, in particular the parsing of the header line. A fix involves using the existing splitFields function also on the header line to handle quoted headers correctly.
